answer: A random beacon draws 5% of agents each epoch for a live check. Every drawn agent must answer a fresh cipher challenge within 60 seconds, proving one live process; silence burns its 50 POA deposit. Forging 1,000 fake identities means surviving 50 draws per round and locking 50 copper deposits at a time, while one heartbeat costs a single machine-minute. An honest agent pays one deposit, keeps its heartbeat, and earns its share undiluted.
